scope: Concise original-source paraphrases/equations for human review; original physical PDF pages, not final A-axis verdicts. No gold or evidence packet is sent to the model.

circular.evidence: Position on a circle is described with radius and radial/tangential unit directions.
circular.fixed_condition: Circular path has constant radius in the defined motion.

circular.evidence: Angular motion is defined relative to an angle coordinate and its time derivative.
circular.fixed_condition: The source coordinate/direction convention determines signed angular velocity versus speed magnitude.

circular.evidence: Velocity follows the tangential direction and depends on radius and angular rate.
circular.fixed_condition: Use the same radius and angular coordinate.

circular.evidence: Uniform motion has constant angular rate and inward radial acceleration.
circular.fixed_condition: Uniform angular rate; no gravitational-orbit model is supplied.

harmonic.evidence: Sinusoidal position is introduced with amplitude, angular frequency and phase.
harmonic.fixed_condition: The displayed sinusoid is a source-defined motion model.

harmonic.evidence: A spring restoring force and Newton's second law give the oscillator equation.
The cosine solution has a natural angular frequency set by spring constant and mass.
The general sine/cosine solution coefficients are related to initial position and velocity.
harmonic.formula_or_concept: x(t) = C cos(omega t) + D sin(omega t)
harmonic.fixed_condition: Given initial conditions define the source baseline; no damping/drive is declared.

circuits.evidence: The capacitor node equation produces a first-order RC differential equation.
The input is constant and the initial capacitor voltage is given.
circuits.fixed_condition: Constant input and specified initial condition.

circuits.evidence: The complete solution approaches the input voltage with time constant RC.
circuits.formula_or_concept: v_C(t) = V_I + (V_0 - V_I) exp(-t/(RC)); tau = RC

circuits.evidence: Charging/discharging examples use input and initial voltage pairs 5/0 and 0/5 volts.
circuits.fixed_condition: The two source example voltage pairs are fixed facts, distinct from a labeled hypothetical exploration.

signals.evidence: The bell recording is periodic, about 2.3 ms per cycle and roughly 439 Hz.
signals.fixed_condition: These are observations of the displayed recording.

signals.evidence: The violin spectrum includes a fundamental near 440 Hz and integer-multiple harmonics.
signals.fixed_condition: The displayed recording/spectrum is source evidence, not regenerated audio.

signals.evidence: The example constructs a cosine at 440 Hz and a sine at 880 Hz with amplitudes 1.0 and 0.5 and zero offsets.
signals.fixed_condition: Example defaults remain identified; code is source data and is never executed.

regression.evidence: The gift-aid example uses a sample of fifty freshmen and compares fitted lines on the observed scatterplot.
regression.formula_or_concept: Least-squares fitting of gift aid versus family income
regression.fixed_condition: The sample and plotted empirical points are source facts.

regression.evidence: The fitted slope uses standard deviations and correlation, and the fitted line passes through the sample means.
The source reports the fitted line and interprets its estimated coefficients.
regression.formula_or_concept: Source fitted intercept approximately 24.319 and slope -0.0431, with axes in thousands
regression.fixed_condition: Fitted estimates are fixed results; prediction input can vary within the observed range.

regression.evidence: Prediction is an estimate subject to cohort and model limitations.
regression.fixed_condition: Do not infer a causal or guaranteed financial-aid rule.

probability.evidence: A fair die illustrates disjoint individual outcomes and their addition rule.
The die events are A={1,2}, B={4,6} and D={2,3}; A and B are disjoint, while A and D share outcome 2.
probability.fixed_condition: Source event membership must remain unchanged.

probability.evidence: Diamonds and face cards require subtracting overlap when computing inclusive-or probability.
probability.formula_or_concept: P(A union B) = P(A) + P(B) - P(A intersection B)
probability.fixed_condition: 52-card example counts are fixed; no unjustified uniform aggregation.

probability.evidence: The two-dice sum table assigns unequal probabilities to sums 2 through 12.
probability.fixed_condition: The sums are not uniformly likely.

search.evidence: Sequential search checks list elements and takes linear work in the worst case; bisection is introduced for sorted lists.
search.fixed_condition: Sorted input is a bisection precondition; no measured timing dataset.

search.evidence: Bisection repeatedly halves the search interval, giving logarithmic complexity; hash-table lookup is discussed separately.
search.formula_or_concept: O(log n) bisection and dictionary/hash-table lookup
search.fixed_condition: Algorithm assumptions remain source-defined; generated code must not execute.

complexity.evidence: Algorithm analysis compares growth as input size increases.
complexity.fixed_condition: Growth class differs from measured machine timing.

complexity.evidence: The illustrative count functions compare a linear expression with a quadratic one.
complexity.fixed_condition: Source coefficients stay fixed; n is illustrative input size.

complexity.evidence: The Big-O table orders common growth classes.
complexity.formula_or_concept: Constant, logarithmic, linear, quadratic and other growth classes

spectrum.evidence: The conversion table presents electromagnetic scales using convenient frequency, wavelength and energy units.
spectrum.formula_or_concept: Examples: 10 kHz corresponds to 30 km; 1 GHz corresponds to 0.3 m
spectrum.fixed_condition: Every printed table cell and size comparison remains unchanged; no zero wavelength or fabricated propagation scene.

debugging.evidence: The appendix distinguishes syntax, runtime and semantic errors and discusses debugging strategy.
debugging.fixed_condition: Category meanings and source advice; no numerical world is declared.

debugging.evidence: Incremental changes and localizing a syntax fault are recommended.
debugging.fixed_condition: Static/formal reading and selection are justified; no executable debugger or drag handle is supplied.
